_readme: Leaderboard data. Rows are rendered by leaderboard.js; keys starting with
an underscore are ignored by the site and exist only as documentation.
To add a result, append an object to `rows` following `_example_row_schema`
and open a GitHub PR (see docs/submission.md).

_example_row_schema.agent: string — submitted agent/model identifier, e.g. my-voice-agent-v2
_example_row_schema.class: string — agent class: A (Text, standard scaffold) | B (Voice, audio-native) | C (Voice, pipeline ASR->LLM->TTS)
_example_row_schema.user_sim: string|null — user-simulator model, null if not applicable/unknown
_example_row_schema.judge: string — outcome judge, e.g. FHIR diff (deterministic)
_example_row_schema.trials: integer — number of i.i.d. trials per task (n)
_example_row_schema.pass_hat: object — pass^k estimates keyed by k as strings; omit keys where k > trials
_example_row_schema.preliminary: boolean — true for smoke-split or otherwise non-final numbers
_example_row_schema.notes: string — free text shown nowhere yet, reserved
